results.title: Ipad
results.text: Fast shipping great price

results.title: Need help with my ipad please
results.text: The iPad screen goes black. I can not turn it on. I’ve taken very good care of the iPad. Hopefully someone can help me with this issue. I’ve tried everything. Nothing works sadly :(

results.title: More useable than laptop
results.text: I bought this iPad Pro while lending out my MacBook. Very easy to use, love the large screen and the apps that allow you to draw/paint/illustrate. Paired it with the Apple keyboard, so versatile.

results.title: Great Buy
results.text: I enjoy this IPad a lot. great resolution and enjoy using this instead of laptop. I also recommended getting the case and keyboard with it.

results.title: Huge Ipad
results.text: I just bought to replace my old computer. Im a little concerned that it might be to big? I want to be able to take it places with me and worried about the size and weight? So I can't decide to keep or return it

results.title: Ipad
results.text: Like the m1 speed and big screen.

results.title: Nice, But Heavy Tablet
results.text: I wanted a tablet. What I got instead was a laptop wannabe. Don't get me wrong. The iPad is nice. It actually comes fairly close to being able to be used as a laptop once you add in a keyboard. But if you want it primarily to be a tablet, I would recommend a smaller iPad. Also, once you add in a keyboard, especially if you opt for Apple's Magic Keyboard, you are in the same price range as a MacBook Air, a farm more capable machine.

results.title: Ipad pro
results.text: l Love the new iPads I purchased.

results.title: New Ipad
results.text: Love the big screen so easy to use!! So many new features.

results.title: Love the larger version of the ipad pro
results.text: Love the size, mobile and easily connects!!!

results.title: Phenomenal Grapics
results.text: This Is The Most Amazing Ipad There is !! I Love How Big the Screen Is And The Picture And Graphics Are Phenomenal!! Doesnt Freeze , Everything Goes Smooth And Is Very Quick!! I Recommend This To Anyone Out there !! It Doesnt Disappoint!!

results.title: iPad 12.9 Buy It
results.text: Gorgeous graphics, large screen. Love!

results.title: Best product
results.text: Best investment ever

results.title: IPad Pro
results.text: Awesome iPad, so many features it’s endless possibilities.

results.title: Love it!
results.text: Out off all my apple products, the iPad is always my favorite. I recently upgraded to the newest iPad model and I love it so much. I actually bought the WiFi + Cellular model. The cellular is must for me. I went with the 1 TB storage option as well. I really just use mine for basic things like watching movies, playing games, web browsing. I’ll use it for work here and there if I have to. It’s very fast and smooth. The display is beautiful. The only con I’d say is sometimes when watching a movie and the screen is dark, there’s some weird “glow”. Hard to explain. It doesn’t bother me much but it’s noticeable.

results.title: endless entertainment
results.text: I bought this as a gift for my husband. He absolutely loves it! It’s a great addition to his other Apple products.

results.title: Awesome
results.text: Awesome, pretty much a Mac Book Pro. Beautiful screen/image/resolution

results.title: Great Purchase , No regrets !!!
results.text: I Luv Luv Luv my new 12.9 in iPad Pro Big Beautiful screen (what blooming ?) fast M1 processer , ProMotion and a thunderbolt/usb c 4 port!!! It’s the ultimate iPad experience, a must buy !

results.title: iPad Pro
results.text: Works just as you would hope. Good purchase. Thank you!

results.title: So Awesome!
results.text: I am so in love with my new iPad Pro. I don’t know how I lived without it. I got the magic keyboard (a must) and also installed Office. I use iCloud Drive so all my docs are synced and accessible across my phone, MacBook, and iPad.

results.title: Must Have
results.text: Fantastic!!!! The speed and ease of use plus the screen resolution and dynamics of what you actually see is off the charts!

results.title: Ipad pro
results.text: The screen is really easy to scratch other than that thoroughly enjoying it. Target has gone above and beyond helping me. I’m very grateful to target they changed the trajectory of my whole week to a positive. Thanks everyone.

results.title: Love
results.text: Definitely recommend this iPad
